attributes.description: At most 32 attributes of the request as it ran, such as resolution. In a server report they replace the decision's attributes of the same key before rating.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer in your system, for a fallback report. An unknown customer is created and follows the default plan. Ignored in a server report.

decision_id.description: Decision the usage belongs to, such as dec_01jbvagescfn78y0938nkrkayd. Required in a server report and rejected in a fallback report. Reporting a decision again returns its first ledger entry.

decision_source.description: Required. server for the usage of a checked decision named by decision_id, fallback for usage that ran without a decision, such as on the fallback outcome while Preburn was unreachable.

feature.description: Feature of your product the usage served, for a fallback report, such as text_to_video. Ignored in a server report.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID you generate for a fallback report. Reporting the same key again returns the first ledger entry. Ignored in a server report.

model.description: Model the request ran on or one of its aliases, for a fallback report, 1 to 200 characters. Ignored in a server report.

occurred_at.description: When the request ran. It picks the prices in effect and, in a fallback report, the customer period. The time of the report when omitted.

provider.description: Provider the request ran on, for a fallback report, 1 to 200 characters. Ignored in a server report.

usage.description: Required. Quantity the request used per meter, a non-negative decimal with at most 6 decimals, such as 6 for output_seconds.

cost.description: USD cost of the usage. Null when it is uncosted.

cost_status.description: uncosted when a meter of the usage has no price.

duplicate.description: True when an earlier report of the same decision or idempotency key stored the entry and this one changed nothing.

ledger_entry_id.description: Ledger entry id, such as led_01jbvagescfn78y0938nkrkayd.

link_url.description: Password reset link, valid for 24 hours. Only this response holds it.

amount.description: Non-negative amount in USD with 9 decimals. The kind sets its sign.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer in your system.

id.description: Revenue entry id, such as rev_01jbvagescfn78y0938nkrkayd.

kind.description: subscription and adjustment add the amount to net revenue. stripe_fee, refund and credit_note subtract it.

period_end.description: End of the period. Equal to period_start for a one-time line.

period_start.description: Start of the period the entry belongs to.

source.description: Where the entry came from: the revenue API, the Stripe connector or a data import.

source_reference.description: Id of the entry in its source, unique per environment, source and kind.

default_plan_id.description: Plan of this environment's customers that have no plan, or null for none.

installation_name.description: Name of the installation, shared by both environments.

stripe_customer_metadata_key.description: Stripe customer metadata key that holds the customer's external id in this environment.

setup_required.description: True until the first member is created through setup.

allowance_remaining.description: Cost allowance minus settled and reserved cost in USD, negative once over the allowance.

cost_allowance.description: AI cost the plan allows in the period in USD.

cost_to_date.description: Settled AI cost of the period in USD.

elapsed_fraction.description: Elapsed share of the period with 4 decimals, at least 0.0100.

pace.description: Share of the allowance spent divided by the elapsed fraction, with 4 decimals, or inf for cost against a zero allowance.

period_revenue_net.description: Net revenue attributed to the period in USD.

projected_margin.description: Margin the period ends with at the current pace, with 4 decimals, or -inf for cost without revenue.

request_estimated_cost.description: Rated cost of the request's usage estimate in USD, null without a request or when the estimate is uncosted.

reserved.description: AI cost held by open reservations in USD.

last_seen_at.description: When the latest of those requests ran.

meter.description: Meter that no rule or override prices.

model.description: Model name the requests were reported with.

provider.description: Provider name the requests ran on.

request_count.description: Requests of the last 90 days whose usage of the meter has no price and no correction.

password.description: Password change. It starts a new session and ends every other session of the member.

billing_increment.description: New positive billing increment, or null for none.

effective_to.description: New end, no earlier than now, or null for no end.

minimum_charge.description: New non-negative minimum charge in USD, or null for none.

native_unit.description: New native unit label, or null for USD. Set or clear it together with native_unit_price.

native_unit_price.description: New USD price of one native unit, or null for USD.

unit_price.description: New non-negative price of unit_quantity units, in the native unit when one is set.

allowance.description: New allowance in USD for a plan in fixed_allowance mode.

hold_times.description: Replaces every hold time. An empty object removes them all.

mode.description: New mode. Switching to fixed_allowance needs an allowance and keeps the stored target margin.

name.description: New name, 1 to 80 characters, unique in the environment.

status.description: archived stops new assignments and fails with 409 plan_is_default for the default plan. active restores the plan.

target_margin.description: New target margin, from 0 to 0.9999 with at most 4 decimals, stored in either mode.

default_plan_id.description: Active plan of this environment for customers that have no plan, or null for none. Any other plan id returns 422 plan_not_found.

stripe_customer_metadata_key.description: New Stripe customer metadata key of this environment, matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$.

display_name.description: Name the dashboard shows, 1 to 200 characters. Omitted or null leaves the customer without one.

metadata.description: JSON object of at most 50 keys and 4096 bytes. Omitted stores an empty object.

plan_id.description: Id of an active plan of the environment. Omitted or null applies the default plan of the environment.

api_key.description: Runtime or admin API key sent as a bearer token.

member_session.description: Member session cookie. Unsafe methods also send the X-CSRF-Token header.
